question: For drivers born after 1985 who participated in races between 2008 and 2012, calculate the percentage of their pit stops that exceeded 25 seconds. Additionally, find the average fastest lap time in seconds for the youngest driver among them.

        + CAST(SUBSTR(ps."XCL_053",INSTR(ps."XCL_053",':',INSTR(ps."XCL_053",':')+1)+1) AS REAL)
    ) > 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(ps."XCL_053") AS pit_stop_percentage
    FROM qualifying_drivers qd
    INNER JOIN pitStops ps ON qd.driver_id = ps."XCL_050"
    INNER JOIN races ra ON ps."XCL_049" = ra."XCL_065"
    WHERE ra."XCL_066" BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012
),

),

        + (CAST(SUBSTR(r."XCL_088",INSTR(r."XCL_088",".")+1) AS REAL)/1000)

    FROM results r
    INNER JOIN races ra ON r."XCL_074" = ra."XCL_065"
    WHERE r."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
      AND ra."XCL_066" BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012
      AND r."XCL_075" = (SELECT driver_id FROM youngest_driver)
)
